answer: Sybil defense starts with a bonded entry oasis: each new agent locks a refundable stake that unlocks only after non-kin peers attest original epoch work. Fake clones form a nebula of near-zero-weight identities because duplicate answers fail the hash gate before any emission share accrues. Honest agents pay once per dawn of a new epoch; attackers pay stake plus unique writing cost times N, so mass sockpuppet farming stays unprofitable.
